events.title: INVOLVEMENT FAIR
events.description: Leonardo played 100 games of chess. We spread the word about SIAM. New faces stopped by, old friends said hello, and we kicked off another semester of mathematics at Illinois Tech.
events.image_alt: SIAM IIT table at the student involvement fair: Glory, Anders, and Leonardo

events.title: PICNIC IN THE PARK
events.description: We kicked off the semester with great food, new connections, and plenty of fun at our Welcome Picnic! Thanks to everyone who joined us and made it memorable.
events.image_alt: Shot of the Welcome Picnic taken by Md Mahmudul Hasan

events.title: OPTIMIZING OVER DISTRIBUTIONS
events.description: The Computational Mathematics and Statistics Seminar returns with Ahmed Attia of Argonne National Laboratory, presenting “Optimizing Over Distributions: A General Approach to Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization.”

events.title: DODGSON'S TEA PARTY
events.description: Join us each week for snacks, mathematics, conversation, and whatever else comes up. Everyone is welcome— no preparation required.
events.image_alt: Solving a problem at Dodgson's Tea Party

events.title: AN INTRODUCTION TO LaTeX WITH TARAN
events.description: Taran Mellacheruvu introduces LaTeX, the standard tool for beautifully typesetting mathematics. Learn the basics of mathematical notation, document formatting, figures, images, useful packages, and resources for continuing your LaTeX journey.

events.title: GAME NIGHT
events.location: P Club, McCormick Tribune Campus Center (near the Welcome Desk)
events.description: Take a break and join us for an evening of games and good company. We’ll have chess, Catan, Nintendo Switch games, and more—all skill levels are welcome.

events.title: GET STARTED WITH MATHEMATICA
events.description: Join us for a seminar with Phileas Dazeley-Gaist, a research fellow at the Wolfram Institute. Phileas will present remotely while attendees gather in person.

events.title: LUNCH WITH A PROFESSOR
events.description: Share a meal and an informal conversation with an Illinois Tech professor at one of our favorite SIAM traditions. The featured professor and additional details will be announced soon.

events.title: MY FAVORITE THEOREM
events.description: An Illinois Tech professor shares a favorite theorem, explaining what makes it beautiful, surprising, or especially useful. The featured speaker and theorem will be announced soon.
